title: Cloaking laminate design based on GPT-vanishing structures
summary: We propose a near-cloaking design which is a lamination of a finite number of layers of isotropic materials. The proposed design is an approximation of a cloaking material obtained by pushing forward a multi-coated structure for which the coating cancels the generalized polarization tensors (GPTs) up to several leading orders.
